project_title: Enterprise Telecom Customer Churn & Financial Friction Analytics

cardinality_defense_plan.dimension_aggregation_strategies: The telecom_users dataset is structured as a 1:1 user profile table. Any future auxiliary service usage or transaction logging tables joined to this entity must be pre-aggregated to distinct IDCliente grain using MAX/SUM operations prior to Star Schema integration to prevent 1-to-Many Cartesian row explosion.
cardinality_defense_plan.entity_resolution_and_key_cleaning: Strip whitespace and enforce uppercase string normalization on IDCliente. Drop index artifacts such as 'Unnamed: 0'. Coerce string-encoded binary variables ('Sim'/'Nao') and categorical service fields into standardized boolean or integer flag formats for high-performance BI analysis.
cardinality_defense_plan.relational_join_sequence: Start with cleansed fact table 'telecom_users' as the central node. Sequentially left-join pre-aggregated demographic, service subscription, and financial billing dimensions on primary key 'IDCliente' to preserve exact row counts.

forensic_enrichment_columns: Average Monthly Spend Velocity: ValorMensal / NULLIF(MesesComoCliente, 0)
Lifetime Financial Commitment Discrepancy: TotalGasto - (ValorMensal * MesesComoCliente)

Service Friction Penalty Index: (CASE WHEN ServicoSuporteTecnico = 'Nao' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN ServicoSegurancaOnline = 'Nao' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN ProtecaoEquipamento = 'Nao' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
assertion_gates: assert len(final_fact) == len(initial_fact), 'Row count mismatch: Cartesian duplicate explosion or row loss occurred!'
assert 'Churn' in final_fact.columns, 'Missing expected dimension features!'

dax_measures: Target Events Count = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(bi_ready_fact), bi_ready_fact[Churn] = 'Sim' || bi_ready_fact[Churn] = 1)
Rate / Percentage % = DIVIDE([Target Events Count], [Total Volume / Records], 0)
Total Financial / Operational Friction Loss ($) = CALCULATE(SUM(bi_ready_fact[TotalGasto]), bi_ready_fact[Churn] = 'Sim' || bi_ready_fact[Churn] = 1)
